course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: An engineering startup is developing a smart wearable device for health monitoring. (12) [CO3] During the development process, the team creates original software, designs a unique product shape and considers using some existing patented technology to improve performance. They also plan to sell their product in international markets.
i) Identify and describe two types of intellectual property that the company could apply to protect its software and product design.
ii) Discuss the possible legal and ethical consequences if the company uses patented technology without permission.
